title: nurt-request/1
description: Request envelope of Danaco Nurt. Exactly one of program, ast, cursor and accept is given; variant applies only to program. The response to a request is described by $defs/response (nurt-response/1).

program.description: Program text in any notation variant.

ast.description: Surface syntax tree nurt-ast/1, equivalent to program.

cursor.description: Cursor of a further page of an earlier result.

accept.description: Identifier of a candidate from an earlier E_AMBIGUOUS error.

options.description: Call options shared by every command; an absent option takes its value from the configuration or the built-in default.

preview.description: Only compute targets and effect; change nothing.

base.description: Absolute directory against which relative paths are resolved.

fields.description: Fields of the result to keep.

max_chars.description: Largest number of characters of a single text field; 0 means no limit.

save_to.description: Absolute path of a file that receives the full result instead of the response.

timeout.description: Time limit of the whole program.

session.description: Session identifier recorded in the journal.

script.description: Script mode: several pipelines, each its own operation.

response.title: nurt-response/1
response.description: Response to a request: the effect report nurt-report/1 and, for text formats, the rendered text.
